documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management stated that FY26 was an exceptional year for Sacheerome, marked by strong growth in revenue, profitability, and operational performance. The fragrance and flavour industry continues to see robust demand supported by rising consumption across FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care sectors. To support future growth, the company is investing in a new manufacturing facility in YEIDA, Uttar Pradesh, where construction is currently underway. Additionally, Sacheerome is expanding its international focus with dedicated R&D and sales teams targeting the Middle East and GCC region.

guidance.claim: Sacheerome remains well positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities and sustain long-term profitable growth.
guidance.quote: With our strengthened balance sheet, healthy cash flows, and scalable operating platform, we remain well positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities and sustain long -term profitable growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The fragrance and flavour industry is experiencing strong demand supported by growing consumption across FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care categories.
demand_outlook.quote: The fragrance and flavour industry continues to witness strong demand supported by growing consumption across FMCG, food & beverage, and personal care categories.

margins_costs.claim: Sacheerome delivered superior margin expansion alongside robust revenue growth in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our ability to deliver superior margin expansion alongside robust revenue growth reflects the strength of our business model, product portfolio, and execution capabilities.

capital_allocation.claim: Sacheerome's debt levels remain minimal and liquidity is well-managed.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt levels remain minimal, indicating financial stability, while liquidity is well-managed.

capital_allocation.claim: A strengthened balance sheet and healthy cash flows are supporting the company's future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: With our strengthened balance sheet, healthy cash flows, and scalable operating platform, we remain well positioned to capitalize on emerging opportunities and sustain long -term profitable growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Business performance could be affected by general market, macroeconomic, regulatory trends, currency and interest rate movements, and competitive pressures.
risks_headwinds.quote: These factors include, but are not limited to, general market, macro economic, governmental and regulatory trends, movements in currency exchange and interest rates, competitive pressures, technological developments, changes in the financial conditions of third parties dealing with us, legislative developments, and other key factors that could affect our business and financial performance .
